title: The fewest coins
description:
Solve change-making for any coins with dynamic programming.

```
coins 1 3 4, amount 6: 2 coins (3 + 3)
coins 2 5, amount 3: impossible
coins 1 5 10 25, amount 63: 6 coins (25 + 25 + 10 + 1 + 1 + 1)
```
hints: Use `INT_MAX` for "impossible so far" and skip coins where `best[a - c]` is impossible (lesson 6.02).
`lastCoin[a] = c` when `c` gave the best answer; then follow `a -= lastCoin[a]` down to 0.
requirements: `best[a]` is the fewest coins for amount `a`; `best[0] = 0`.
Fill it from 1 up: `best[a] = 1 + min over coins c <= a of best[a - c]`.
Keep which coin was used last so you can print the coins.
stretch: Count the number of different ways to make the amount.
